name: Black Tea
siboNotes: Plain black tea is well-tolerated and may have antimicrobial properties that could benefit SIBO management. Avoid adding high FODMAP sweeteners or milk.
preparationTips: Brew with plain water only - avoid adding regular milk or honey
Steep for 3-5 minutes for optimal flavor without excessive tannins
Use lactose-free milk or small amounts of maple syrup if sweetening needed
Cold brewing reduces tannin content and may be gentler on sensitive stomachs
